system.description: A overgrown forest where the paths are narrow and visibility is poor
system.notes:
Standard | Exploration

A overgrown forest where the paths are narrow and visibility is poor
Impulses: Ambush the unwary, block safe passage

Difficulty: 12

Features

Signs of Trouble - Passive: The forest shows signs of recent human activity. A PC can make an Instinct Roll to notice details. On a success with Hope, learn all three pieces of information below. On a success with Fear, learn two. On a failure, a PC can mark 3 Stress to learn one and gain Advantage on the next roll to deal with this environment. A PC with a relevant background or Experience can learn an additional detail and ask a follow-up question about what they find, receiving a truthful answer.

  • Bootprints and broken branches suggest several people passed through recently, moving off the path.
  • A makeshift campsite nearby shows signs of a quick and hasty departure.
  • Scratched trees mark the edge of some sort of site.

Falling Branches - Action: Pick a point along the path. All targets within Very Close range must succeed on a Finesse Reaction Roll or take 1d8+3 physical damage as a branch trap or deadfall crashes down. Those who fail are Restrained until freed with a successful Brawn Roll or by removing the debris.

Bandit Ambush - Action: A Bandit Shadow, two Bandit Archers, and a number of Bandit Lackeys equal to the number of PCs attack from cover, using the terrain for Advantage.

Call for Reinforcements - Action: Spend a Fear to summon 1d4 Bandit Lackeys, who arrive from Far range and immediately act.
